_readme: The classes a build agent's blocker reason can belong to (DRE-6438). Read only through scripts/blocker_class.py; `python3 scripts/blocker_class.py check` holds this file to the contract, and docs/blocker-classes.md is the page a person reads. A note's first line `<stamp><class>` names its class outright; otherwise the class is the one whose `phrases` (lower-case substrings) appear in the reason, and a reason naming none, or more than one, is the `default`. Every class names the `scripts/<action>.py` that resolves it. The vocabulary is the contract of the blocker-class epic, identical in every card of it.

nothing-to-change.means: Every acceptance criterion is already met on the default branch, so there is no change to open a pull request for.
phrases: nothing for this card to change

wrong-repo.means: The card's files live in a different repository from the one its repo label dispatched the run into.

branch-without-pr.means: The work is built and pushed on the card's branch, but the run opened no pull request for it.

question.means: The reason needs a person's answer before the card can move, and the sweep asks it.
